timing_protocol.first_fit_in_warm_process: first estimator fit for that scenario/ties/penalty/backend; may include estimator or proximal first-use compilation
timing_protocol.steady_state_fit: second fresh estimator fit immediately after the first fit
timing_protocol.performance_timing: one synchronized warmup is excluded, then five synchronized fresh-estimator fits are timed and summarized by the median
timing_protocol.interpretation: diagnostic warm-process timing, not fresh-Python cold-start latency
